en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika), The Triplet on the Inferior (Hīnattika)

Conditioned by a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not inferior, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and inferior, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not intermediate, there arises a state that is visible, reacting, and intermediate, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Twenty-one under root; twenty-one under predominance; ... pe ... twenty-one under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and not sublime, there arises a phenomenon that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and sublime, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
